app.stylePowerBlurb: Deterministic, auditable output. Per-activity reports with exact numbers. Framework citations on every numeric claim.
app.styleCoachTag: Inherits Power-athlete + roster framing for managing other athletes
app.styleEnthusiastBlurb: Mostly prose, with a small data block when it actually changes the recommendation. Citations only when you ask why.
app.styleEnthusiastTag: Prose plus the numbers that matter
app.styleCoachBlurb: Same Power-athlete discipline, plus per-athlete tenant-scoped reports and roster-wide summaries.
app.styleCasualBlurb: Talks to you like a knowledgeable friend texting a quick reply. Round numbers, plain language, short replies.
app.styleCasualBullet1: Prose, not bullet lists. No structured blocks.
app.styleCasualBullet2: No framework citations or technical acronyms.
app.styleCasualBullet3: Only urgent (P0) push notifications — weekly digest otherwise.
app.styleEnthusiastBullet1: Headline answer first, key datum second. Replies under ~250 words.
app.styleEnthusiastBullet2: Acronyms (CTL, ACWR) glossed on first use, then used freely.
app.styleEnthusiastBullet3: P0 + P1 unsolicited push (acute injury risk, near-overreached).
app.stylePowerBullet1: Line-by-line activity blocks with framework labels (Coggan, Banister, Foster).
app.stylePowerBullet2: Full P0–P3 readiness ladder verbatim. 10-point validation checklist.
app.stylePowerBullet3: Full P0/P1/P2 unsolicited push. Pre-workout briefing on request.
app.styleCoachBullet1: Athlete-scoped queries — never cross-aggregate the coach and their athletes.
app.styleCoachBullet2: Roster-wide blocks (e.g. ACWR > 1.3 across the squad).
app.styleCoachBullet3: Full P0/P1/P2 push for every athlete; P3 only for the coach themselves.
